svg.title: Gray wolf
svg.desc: Standing gray wolf with a deep-chested canid frame, long limbs, gray layered coat, broad muzzle, and lowered bushy tail. Biological basis: Wolves are used mainly in comparative behavior, population genetics, disease ecology, and canid evolutionary research.
